# Pull Request Template

## Description
Please describe the changes you've made and why.

## Type of Change
- [ ] Bug fix
- [ ] New feature
- [ ] UI/UX improvement
- [ ] Documentation update
- [ ] Dependency update
- [ ] Other (please describe)

## Checklist
- [ ] I have read the contributing guidelines
- [ ] I have run `npm run build` (frontend) and `./gradlew assembleDebug` (Android)
- [ ] I have tested my changes manually
- [ ] I have updated the README.md if needed
- [ ] My code follows the project's style guidelines
- [ ] I have added or updated relevant documentation

## Screenshots/GIFs (if UI change)
Include screenshots or GIFs demonstrating the changes.

## Breaking Changes
Are there any breaking changes? If so, please describe the migration path.

## Linked Issues
Fixes #(issue number) - or - Related to #(issue number)
